questions.question: What comfort does God give in Isaiah 43?
options: Fear not, I have redeemed you and called you by name
Bring offerings, that I may forgive your sins
Depart from me, for you have forsaken me
Prepare yourselves for war, for your enemies draw near
questions.answer: Fear not, I have redeemed you and called you by name

questions.question: What does God promise about passing through waters and fire?
options: You will sink down beneath the deep waters and the fire will consume you whole
Keep yourself far away from them both, lest the flood and the flame destroy you
They will rise up against you and will surely sweep you all away in their great fury
When you pass through them, I will be with you; they shall not overwhelm you
questions.answer: When you pass through them, I will be with you; they shall not overwhelm you
